item.title: Cruise ship passengers 'stranded' in Cambodia after '6.30am eviction notice'
item.description: Around 200 passengers aboard the Villa Vie Odyssey were left stranded in Sihanoukville, Cambodia, with no help with accommodation or onward travel
item.author: Helena Vesty
item.media:keywords: Cruise news, Petrol prices, Travel advice, Villa Vie Residences, Cambodia, Cruise ship eviction, Fuel cost crisis

media:content.media:description: Villa Vie Residences' Odyssey cruise ship passengers Randy Cassingham and his wife Kit Cassingham speak during an interview at a hotel in Sihanoukville, Preah Sihanouk province, on October 28, 2026. Around 200 passengers who paid to live on a cruise ship while travelling the world were abruptly left in a Cambodian port after the company ran out of money, an official said on October 28. (Photo by TANG CHHIN Sothy / AFP via Getty Images)
